nodes.description: Investigate the bounded context and submit a typed DiscoveryProposal.
nodes.label: Produce Discovery Proposal

nodes.description: Materialize the exact raw submission or canonical Proposal persisted by proposal_submit.
nodes.label: Resolve Proposal Submission

nodes.description: Create the exact normalization ControlIntent, authority WorkIntent, and projected task.
nodes.label: Prepare Normalization Control

nodes.description: Transform only ambiguous source fields without inventing evidence.
nodes.label: Normalize Semantic Ambiguity

nodes.description: Materialize the exact canonical Proposal accepted by normalization_submit.
nodes.label: Resolve Normalized Proposal

nodes.description: Create the readiness ControlIntent + authority WorkIntent + projected task for the canonical proposal.
nodes.label: Prepare Readiness Control

nodes.description: Produce an advisory, source-bound readiness assessment for the canonical proposal.
nodes.label: Assess Readiness

nodes.description: Materialize the exact accepted assessment, or an explicit missing/failed/paused readiness result.
nodes.label: Resolve Readiness Assessment

nodes.description: Apply the versioned policy and issue the immutable authoritative certificate.
nodes.label: Settle Discovery

nodes.label: Complete: go

nodes.label: Complete: clarify

nodes.description: Emit the local Discovery process outcome 'reject'.
nodes.label: Complete: reject

identity.description: Turns an idea or problem into an authoritative discovery outcome certificate.
identity.name: product-discovery

invariants.description: LM workers propose but never settle or advance the lifecycle.
Only deterministic kernel policy issues the authoritative certificate.
Known ids, hashes, schema versions and authority context are machine-filled.
Every LM execution uses an external tracker as its program counter and recovery frame.
Typed MCP submissions are materialized and checklist-verified before invocation.
Diagnosis may explain but never alter the certificate or route.

outcomes.description: The subject is sufficiently grounded to continue.
Material information is missing or contradictory.
The subject should not continue under the current evidence and policy.
The subject is valid but should be reconsidered later.
Discovery completed without enough basis for another decision.
Discovery infrastructure could not produce an authoritative result.

policies.description: The sole authority that converts proposal and readiness evidence into a decision.
